title: Luvs Creator Price Index
description:
Monthly aggregate statistics on subscription pricing and discounting in the subscription creator economy, computed from publicly visible profile data.

Each release reports, for one calendar month: the mean and median price actually charged after every discount in effect, the mean advertised list price measured on the same profiles, the share of priced profiles running a discount, the share of those discounts that have run without a break for 90 days or more, the median discount depth, and the number of priced profiles the row was computed on.

Aggregates only. There are no usernames, no identifiers and no row that describes one person, and any breakdown is published only where at least 15 profiles back it. A release is frozen when the month closes; a correction is published openly and recorded in the changelog, never applied silently.

Column definitions, the computation of every metric and the known limitations are in CODEBOOK.md in this archive and at https://luvs.one/research
